name: Datadog
description: Metrics, logs, traces and monitors in your Datadog organisation.
long_description:
Datadog's hosted server. It queries metrics, searches logs and traces, reads monitors and dashboards, and looks at incidents.

You sign in through Datadog in your browser. Reading is what this is for; a monitor change is production behaviour and is confirmed.

auth.instructions: Sign in to Datadog in your browser; the server registers Gantry on the spot.

risk.notes: Reads your telemetry. Changing a monitor changes who gets paged.
